scope: Rights/permission fields that a provider's image search or file-info response exposes per result, as published in the provider's own API documentation. This compares response shape, not legal advice and not whether a license is suitable for a use.

dimensions.label: License identifier per result
dimensions.why: Lets a pipeline branch on the license without scraping the landing page.

dimensions.label: License deed / legal-terms URL
dimensions.why: Lets an interface link a user to the exact terms that apply to this result.

dimensions.label: Verbatim license text
dimensions.why: Lets a reviewer see exactly what the source published, unparaphrased.

dimensions.label: Ready-to-use attribution string
dimensions.why: Removes the copy-paste error that drops a required credit.

dimensions.label: Attribution-required flag
dimensions.why: Tells automation whether a credit is mandatory or optional for this result.

dimensions.label: Commercial-use flag
dimensions.why: Blocks a commercial publish that the license forbids.

dimensions.label: Derivative-works flag
dimensions.why: Says whether cropping, recoloring or remixing is permitted.

dimensions.label: Share-alike flag
dimensions.why: Warns when a derivative must carry the same license.

dimensions.label: Provenance / source landing URL
dimensions.why: Links a result back to the page it was collected from.

providers.name: Lightdrift

license_url.field: rights.license (when the value is a URL)
license_url.quote: cc-by , cc-by-sa , cc-by-nc , pdm , us-gov-pd , … license_verbatim The license text exactly as the source published it.

license_verbatim.quote: license_verbatim The license text exactly as the source published it.

attribution_text.quote: attribution A ready-to-use attribution string (title, author, source, license). null when not required.

commercial_allowed.quote: commercial Whether commercial use is permitted.

derivatives_allowed.quote: derivatives Whether derivative works are permitted.

share_alike.quote: share_alike Whether derivatives must carry the same license.

provenance_url.quote: provenance_url The source page the asset and its declaration were collected from.

notes: Rights are reported as declared by the source and normalized into one machine-readable shape: "We collect the license and permission information a source publishes alongside each image and normalize it into one machine-readable shape." (rights guide).
reporting a rights answer is not the same as clearing a use; the guide says hosting does not clear an image.

providers.name: Openverse

license_identifier.quote: license: string :: The name of license for the media.

license_url.quote: license_url: string :: A direct link to the license deed or legal terms.

license_verbatim.quote: license_version: string :: The version of the media license.
license_verbatim.basis: The Image schema documents license and license_version but no verbatim license-text field.

attribution_text.quote: attribution: string :: Legally valid attribution for the media item in plain-text English.

attribution_required.quote: license: string :: The name of license for the media.
attribution_required.basis: No boolean attribution-required field is documented; the requirement is implied by the license identifier.

commercial_allowed.quote: license: string :: The name of license for the media.
commercial_allowed.basis: No boolean permission fields are documented; the caller maps the license identifier to its conditions.

derivatives_allowed.quote: license: string :: The name of license for the media.
derivatives_allowed.basis: No boolean permission fields are documented; the caller maps the license identifier to its conditions.

share_alike.quote: license: string :: The name of license for the media.
share_alike.basis: No boolean permission fields are documented; the caller maps the license identifier to its conditions.

provenance_url.quote: foreign_landing_url: string :: The landing page of the work.

notes: creator and creator_url are also documented per result and are used to build a credit when attribution is empty.

providers.name: Wikimedia Commons

license_url.field: extmetadata.LicenseUrl (extension key; not populated on the sampled file)
license_url.basis: The sampled public-domain file has no LicenseUrl key; the key set is not guaranteed for every file, so treat it as optional.

attribution_text.basis: Artist and Credit are HTML fragments, not a single ready-to-use plain-text credit; a caller must strip markup.

commercial_allowed.quote: extmetadata Lists formatted metadata combined from multiple sources.
commercial_allowed.basis: No commercial-use boolean is documented in the core extmetadata property list; the caller maps the license.

derivatives_allowed.quote: extmetadata Lists formatted metadata combined from multiple sources.
derivatives_allowed.basis: No derivative-works boolean is documented; the caller maps the license.

share_alike.quote: extmetadata Lists formatted metadata combined from multiple sources.
share_alike.basis: No share-alike boolean is documented; the caller maps the license.

notes: extmetadata is HTML formatted by the API description: "Results are HTML formatted." Plan to sanitize before display.

providers.name: Pixabay

license_identifier.quote: id :: A unique identifier for this image.
license_identifier.basis: The documented image hit fields list no license field; the license is applied site-wide, not per result.

license_url.quote: pageURL :: Source page on Pixabay, which provides a download link for the original image
license_url.basis: No license or terms URL field is documented in the image hit.

license_verbatim.quote: id :: A unique identifier for this image.
license_verbatim.basis: No license-text field is documented in the image hit.

attribution_text.quote: userImageURL :: Profile picture URL (250 x 250 px).
attribution_text.basis: A contributor name (user) and profile image are returned, but no ready-to-use attribution string or contributor profile URL field.

attribution_required.quote: id :: A unique identifier for this image.
attribution_required.basis: No attribution-required flag is documented in the image hit.

commercial_allowed.quote: id :: A unique identifier for this image.
commercial_allowed.basis: No commercial-use flag is documented in the image hit.

derivatives_allowed.quote: id :: A unique identifier for this image.
derivatives_allowed.basis: No derivative-works flag is documented in the image hit.

share_alike.quote: id :: A unique identifier for this image.
share_alike.basis: No share-alike flag is documented in the image hit.

provenance_url.quote: pageURL :: Source page on Pixabay, which provides a download link for the original image of the dimension imageWidth x imageHeight

notes: The applicable license is site-wide; this comparison records only what the search response exposes and does not restate license terms, because the license-summary page could not be retrieved in this environment (Cloudflare challenge).

out_of_scope.reason: The API guidelines page is retrievable and states an attribution and link-back requirement, but the runtime documentation page does not expose the response field table as retrievable text, and the license page returned an anti-bot challenge (HTTP 401) in this environment. Not included rather than guessed.
The API documentation page returned HTTP 403 in this environment and could not be captured.
